_comment: Navigate to Correlation Rules, choose import, select file, import.

ruleDefinitions.name: Regsvr32 Execution with Suspicious URL in Command
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of regsvr32.exe where the command line contains a URL (http, https). This may indicate suspicious use of Regsvr32 to download or execute remote content.

sequences.name: Windows event
sequences.query: event_code: "4688" AND process_name: "regsvr32.exe" AND process_command_line: RGXi("/i") AND process_command_line: RGXi("https?") AND process_command_line: RGXi("\.sct|\.ocx")
